_doc: Fixed input sequence, used by the page's per-device auto-pick (timed) and by web/test (WASM vs native C core). Starts from MPCConfig.x0 with MPC on at step 0; at each event's step k the parameters [target_x, target_y, obs_x, obs_y] change before that step. The obstacle is the demo video's; the switch at k = 60 moves the target across the obstacle (the hard solves).
